close_reason: MemoryBackend ignores properties hint by design (it's a test backend); document in trait comment
description: email.rs:1595-1598 — collapse_by_thread passes properties=[id,threadId] to get_objects to avoid fetching body data. MemoryBackend (mod.rs:217) ignores _properties entirely, so all up to 65536 Email objects are fully deserialized from JSON. A thread-collapsed query on a large account deserializes the full email graph including body parts. Fix: MemoryBackend.get_objects should honour the properties hint by deserializing only requested fields, or the backend contract should be documented as advisory only and the cap lowered.
title: collapse_by_thread: MemoryBackend ignores properties hint, deserializes full Email objects
